title: Sourced local election and ballot rules

producer.writes: Municipal election law for 51 jurisdictions, and runoff and ranked-choice counting (municipal-ballot-rules.ts#tabulateBallot).
producer.runsDetail: The three files reach only each other. Play uses a different municipalRulePackFor in municipal-government.ts:574. MUNICIPAL_RULES_AUDIT_GATE keeps the sourced values off candidacy screens until a source audit promotes them.

missing.reader: A city election using its own counting rule
missing.detail: A source audit must promote the rule values first. Then the election handler reads the tabulator.
